title: Let helplessness tell the truth
summary: Pain can wake dependence when pleasure has kept the heart asleep. Return the tired body to refuge before asking more of it.
takeaway: Return the tired body to refuge before asking more of it.
lifeApplication: Before pushing harder, name what this body can honestly carry today and receive the help already near.

source.shortMeaning: Pain can wake dependence when pleasure has kept the heart asleep.
